summary: Sourced local evidence is thin: the only district-specific complaints found are unpaid sugarcane dues and a demand for a better cane price, while most civic complaints (water, drains, power, roads) are unverified inference.

positives.english: *Darul Uloom's name keeps Deoband known across the country
positives.hindi: *दारुल उलूम से देवबंद की पहचान देश-विदेश तक है
positives.basis: Inference: no source opened for this claim; Darul Uloom's presence in Deoband is well known but was not verified in this session.

positives.english: *Local bazaar and shops stay open and busy through the day
positives.hindi: *देवबंद का बाज़ार दिनभर खुला रहता है, दुकानें चलती रहती हैं
positives.basis: Inference: no source opened for this claim; a general town-level impression, not verified.

positives.english: *Students come from far away to study in Deoband's schools
positives.hindi: *दूर-दूर से छात्र यहाँ पढ़ने आते हैं, शिक्षा का नाम है
positives.basis: Inference: no source opened for this claim; linked to the Darul Uloom profile of the town, not verified.

positives.english: *Municipal board claims it supplies water and sewage to homes
positives.hindi: *नगर पालिका का दावा है कि घरों तक नल और नाली की सुविधा है
positives.basis: Inference: the Wikipedia Deoband page says Deoband Nagar Palika Parishad 'supplies basic amenities like water and sewage' (tagged [citation needed]); this is a claim, not a voter-recognised improvement.

positives.english: *Town is about 150 km from Delhi, reachable by road
positives.hindi: *दिल्ली से करीब 150 किलोमीटर, सड़क से आना-जाना संभव है
positives.basis: Inference: the Wikipedia Deoband page gives the distance from Delhi (about 150 km); 'reachable by road' is not separately verified.

negatives.english: Sugar mills still owe cane growers money, when will payment come?
negatives.hindi: चीनी मिलों पर गन्ना किसानों का बकाया है, पैसा कब मिलेगा?
negatives.basis: District-level (Saharanpur), dated 3 June 2021: mills paid Rs 100.34 crore that day, Deoband mill's share Rs 19 crore, and 'जिले की शुगर मिलों पर अभी भी 630 करोड़ रुपये गन्ना मूल्य के बकाया हैं'. Old (2021), not a 2024-2026 source.

negatives.english: Farmers want cane price of Rs 600 per quintal, or farming won't pay
negatives.hindi: गन्ने का भाव 600 रुपये क्विंटल हो, तभी खेती का गुज़ारा होगा
negatives.basis: District-level (Saharanpur), dated 7 January 2023: BKU (Verma) workers submitted a memorandum to DM Akhilesh Singh in Saharanpur demanding 'गन्ना मूल्य 600 रुपये प्रति क्विंटल घोषित' (headline: 'गन्ना मूल्य 600 रुपये क्विंटल घोषित हो'). Not Deoband-town-specific; 2023, not 2024-2026.

negatives.english: *Drains and water supply in the town are poor, complaints go unheard
negatives.hindi: *नल और नाली की व्यवस्था ठीक नहीं, शिकायत कौन सुने
negatives.basis: Inference: the Wikipedia Deoband page says Deoband Nagar Palika Parishad 'supplies basic amenities like water and sewage' (tagged [citation needed]). No Deoband complaint report was found or opened; the complaint itself is unverified.

negatives.english: *Low voltage and power cuts stop fans and coolers from working
negatives.hindi: *बिजली कटौती और कम वोल्टेज से पंखे-कूलर ठीक से नहीं चलते
negatives.basis: Inference: no Deoband-specific source found. Low-voltage complaints surfaced only for Bihar and other UP towns (Raebareli, Fatehpur), not this AC.

negatives.english: *Encroachment and traffic jams on town roads are a daily trouble
negatives.hindi: *सड़क पर अतिक्रमण और दुकानों के आगे जाम रोज़ की परेशानी है
negatives.basis: Inference: no Deoband-specific source found. Encroachment-related jam reports were from other UP towns (Siddharthnagar, Muzaffarnagar), not this AC.

notes: Search budget was exhausted mid-research (WebSearch limit reached), so coverage is incomplete. Only 2 negatives are backed by opened, district-level sources (both Saharanpur district, not Deoband-town-specific; the 2021 and 2023 dates are older than the 2024-2026 preference). The brief requires at least 3 of 5 negatives to be AC/district-specific; that is NOT met with verified sources. Negative 3 is Deoband-named but its complaint is inference. All positives are inference with no opened source. Not verified: current Deoband water, drain, road, power, and cane-dues situation for 2024-2026; Hindi local outlets (Amar Ujala/Dainik Jagran/Hindustan Saharanpur editions) were not successfully searched for Deoband-specific civic news. Searches for Deoband roads/water/electricity/jams returned only other towns. Identity confirmed from Wikipedia: AC No. 5, Deoband, Saharanpur district, reserved status None, parent Lok Sabha Saharanpur. MLA name conflicts between sources (Wikipedia: Brijesh Singh, BJP, 2017; Patrika 2022 profile: Brijesh Rawat, BJP, 2017) and was not used. Patrika (31 Jan 2022) mentions an ATS commando centre announced for Deoband; it is politically framed, so it was excluded. Field check recommended: Deoband Nagar Palika water/drain status, Saharanpur sugar mill cane dues 2025-26 (Deoband mill), UPPCL low-voltage complaints for Deoband, and traffic/encroachment in Deoband bazaar.
